## Feature or gap

Describe the user need and current behavior.

## Evidence

Link the current limitation or give commands and output that show the gap.

## Proposed result

Describe how shared code stays generic.

## Owned scope

Who owns the work? Which files or components can change? What is outside scope?

## Dependencies

List blocking issues, tools and owner decisions. Write "none" if there are none.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Define an observable result and its verification command.
- [ ] Attach evidence for each completed check. Mark missing evidence as not run or inconclusive.
